title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft has published no agent-monitoring licence is no longer accurate. The Purview service description names Microsoft 365 E7 and Agent365 SKUs for agentic workloads, although it describes their support in future tense; the roadmap scope, default policy and auditing controls remain supported.
